schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
schemes.target_audience: Micro and small non-farm enterprises, trading, manufacturing, and services

categories.target: Established units looking to purchase equipment or working capital

schemes.collateral_required: None (guaranteed by Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units - CGFMU)
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens with a viable business plan in non-farm sector.

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.incentives: 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on timely repayment, plus cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.target_audience: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises
schemes.margin_money: 15% (can converge with other state/central subsidy schemes)
schemes.repayment_tenure: Up to 7 years with a moratorium period of up to 18 months.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (PMAY)
schemes.target_audience: EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Groups (MIG-I, MIG-II) purchasing first residential house
schemes.subsidy_benefit: Up to ₹2.67 Lakh upfront interest subsidy discounted from principal.

schemes.name: RBI Charter of Customer Rights - Failed Transactions (Turnaround Time TAT)

rules.scenario: ATM cash withdrawal failure (account debited but cash not dispensed)
rules.penalty: ₹100 per day compensation payable to customer for delay beyond T+5

rules.scenario: UPI transfer debited but not credited to beneficiary
rules.penalty: ₹100 per day compensation if delay exceeds T+1
